invariants.title: The inside is photographs
invariants.rule: Every frame is one of the cafe's own interior photographs, panned across. Nothing in this shot is generated, extended or filled in. stitched into a real panorama — and inventing the joins would mean inventing the inside of the cafe, which this film has never done.

invariants.title: It reads as one continuous turn
invariants.rule: The motion never stops and never reverses. The joins are cross-dissolves timed to land mid-move, so the eye reads rotation rather than four cuts.

invariants.title: It ends on her at the counter
invariants.rule: The last view is 5-1.jpg and it eases to a stop with the owner behind the counter. She is what the shot is for.

flair.title: How much of each photograph is seen at once
flair.note: CROP_W 0.80. Lower means a tighter window and a longer travel across each picture.

title: Inside, the room turns past us and she is behind the counter
beat: We are inside the cafe. The camera turns steadily through the room — the yellow wall and the window tables, the brick wall with its chalkboards and pictures — and settles on the counter, where the owner is standing.
